physical_scope: Finite-resolution SIDM core contraction, heating and outward transport. Quantitative late collapse times and central structure require locality and numerical convergence checks.
radial_variance: Centered radial variance. WPIC radial_variance is direct; SphDSMC p/rho is already centered.

sidm_cored.initial_model: Isotropic halo with density proportional to x^(-0.1)*(1+x^4)^(-0.975), where x=r/r_s
sidm_cored.population: Equal-mass particle count per diagnostic bin
